text: Given a prompt, I can name which of the seven deep-dive patterns it will trigger and point to the clue in the requirements or numbers.
I can derive a hybrid fan-out threshold from spare capacity and explain the scatter-gather tail with 0.99²⁰⁰.
I can walk a payment timeout through an unknown state to one charge, naming the idempotency key at each hop.
I can choose strong or eventual consistency per operation, and fail open or closed per rule, and justify each from the requirements.
I can size a burst with Little's law and describe admission control, separate lanes and jittered retries with their costs.
I can compute the per-region capacity needed to survive a region loss and tell a failure timeline for it.
